entities.summary: Ruth Charlotte Ellis was an African-American LGBT rights activist and the one of the oldest surviving open lesbians at the age of 101. Her life is celebrated in Yvonne Welbon's documentary film Living With Pride: Ruth C. Ellis @ 100.
